name: readout-placebo96
cmd: set -e; for spec in desk_tempho_1995_s1:1996 desk_tempho_1985_s1:1986; do IFS=: read -r cc t0 <<< "$spec"; mkdir -p {out}/$cc; {python} research/exp/readout_scaling.py --cache {cache}/$cc --out {out}/$cc --t0 $t0 --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5; done
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do {python} research/exp/readout_scaling.py --summarize $d | head -3; done
note: E033c: the position x time placebo with 96 features x 5 draws vs the split readout, paired bootstrap
